descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S19 Search text edges, both contexts: apostrophes, hyphens, accents, partial and cross-field numbers

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 2; TFA-92581 AC 5)
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own. (UAT TC-03; TFA-92581 AC 3; TFA-92581 AC 6)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital: O'Brien 21, Smith-Jones 22, José Núñez 23, Patel 410, Ortiz 41, Novak 12 with MRN 'MRN-4100', Lund 7 with age 41 and MRN 'MRN-7000'. Nursing Home on Today's Visits: D'Angelo 'Rm 4', Patel 'Rm 410', Ortiz 'Rm 41', Novak 'Rm 12' with MRN 'MRN-4100'

When Hospital: search "o'brien", "jones", "José", '410', '41'. Nursing Home Today's Visits: search "d'angelo", '41'

Then Each name search lists exactly the named record. '410' lists Patel, not Ortiz or Lund. '41' lists Patel and Ortiz, not Lund (age is not a search field), in both contexts

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): cp1–cp3 mustContain the named patient and mustNotContain the other two punctuation names. cp4 mustContain Patel, mustNotContain Ortiz, Lund. cp5 mustContain Patel, Ortiz, mustNotContain Lund. cp6 mustContain QA Resident D'Angelo, mustNotContain QA Resident Ortiz and QA Hosp O'Brien. …

Where it ran: dev unit U73; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
